name: WhatsApp
setupGuide: WhatsApp needs YOUR OWN Meta app — Studio never brokers this. At https://developers.facebook.com create an app, add the WhatsApp product, and from its API Setup page copy the phone number id and a permanent access token (generate one from a System User in Business Settings; the sample token shown there expires in 24 hours). Message your own number from that page once, so WhatsApp will let the number receive messages back.
_localNote: Studio can broker this. Only tools marked "local": true can be called — the rest are hosted-platform only.
